answer: The dermal papilla (Dp) is marked by NDP and SOX2 (NDP+, SOX2+); formation of the Dp is also characterized by expression of RSPO3 and WNT5A, which coordinate differentiation of adjacent hair matrix cells.
support_quote: Following HF invagination, the Dc becomes encapsulated at its base as the Dp (NDP + , SOX2 + ) 26,28 (Fig. 2c and Extended Data Fig. 3h).
